faqs.question: What appliances do you repair?
faqs.answer: Appliance Helpers connects you with technicians who repair major household appliances, including refrigerators, washers, dryers, dishwashers, ovens, ranges, cooktops, freezers, ice makers, microwaves, garbage disposals, and more.

faqs.question: Can I get same-day appliance repair?
faqs.answer: Same-day and next-day appointments are often available, depending on technician schedules in your area. Call {{phone}} and we will match you with the earliest local opening.

faqs.question: Do you repair all appliance brands?
faqs.answer: Yes. Independent technicians in the network work on nearly every major brand and model, including Whirlpool, GE, Samsung, LG, Maytag, KitchenAid, Bosch, Frigidaire, Kenmore, and many others.

faqs.question: How does scheduling work?
faqs.answer: Call {{phone}}, describe the appliance and the problem, and we will connect you with a local technician. They diagnose the issue in your home, explain the work, and give you a quote before any repair begins.

faqs.question: Will I know the price before work begins?
faqs.answer: Yes. You receive an up-front quote after the technician diagnoses the problem, and no repair work starts until you approve it. There is no obligation to proceed.

faqs.question: What areas do you serve?
faqs.answer: Appliance Helpers connects homeowners with local appliance repair technicians in their area. After you call, we match you with a nearby technician when one is available.

faqs.question: How does Appliance Helpers work?
faqs.answer: Appliance Helpers is a free referral service. We connect you with independent local appliance repair technicians. Those technicians are not employed by Appliance Helpers, and you choose whether to move forward after you receive a quote.
